[C] FloatingBox variants
========================================================
FloatingBox
  +-- FloatingPane (stored in DisplayState.nodes)
  |     shared DisplayNodeBase
  |       id / childIds / expansion / expandedGeometry?
  |       position{x,y}, bounds{width,height}
  |       coordinateSpace: canvas | viewport
  |       policy: automatic/manual + content/fixed
  |     |
  |     +-- selection: SelectionRegion
  |     |     sourceBoxId/contentId/ascii/revisionId?
  |     |     rect + selectedIds + stacked/chained
  |     +-- projection: ProjectedPane
  |     |     title + projection/revision IDs?
  |     |     call-tree | compaction
  |     |     source-code | code-panel
  |     +-- conversation: ConversationPane
  |     |     thread + draft + canvasAnchor
  |     |     compact | floating | docked
  |     +-- detail: title + ascii + sectionId?
  +-- arrow: derived by drawEdge(document.edges)
DisplayState: rootIds -> childIds ownership tree
  stacked -> activeChildId; chained -> child traversal
SelectionState owns membership; region pane is context
Sources: displayModel.ts; canvasDisplayNode.ts
